insights: CCB Contractor Licensing: Oregon requires contractor licensing through CCB Oregon Construction Contractors Board (CCB) licenses all contractors—verify at ccb.oregon.gov. License numbers must appear on contracts and advertising. Reddit appreciates the strong consumer protection.

Western Oregon Moisture: Western Oregon receives heavy rainfall and constant moisture Portland area gets 150+ days of rain. Reddit strongly emphasizes proper flashing, ventilation, and moisture management. Mold prevention is critical.

Seismic Risk: Oregon faces significant earthquake risk, especially near the coast The Cascadia Subduction Zone poses major risk. Reddit recommends seismic retrofitting for older homes, especially those with cripple walls or unreinforced masonry.
Roof Moss & Algae: Western Oregon Moss damages roofing materials over time. Reddit recommends zinc or copper strips at the ridge, regular cleaning, and algae-resistant shingles.
